verses.english: The Chapter of Abbreviated Texts Beginning with Greed
“For insight into greed, two things should be developed.

verses.pali: Rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime dve dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.
verses.english: For insight into greed, these two things should be developed.”

verses.pali: “Rāgassa, bhikkhave, pariññāya … parikkhayāya … pahānāya … khayāya … vayāya … virāgāya … nirodhāya … cāgāya … paṭinissaggāya dve dhammā bhāvetabbā …pe…
verses.english: “For the complete understanding … finishing … giving up … ending … vanishing … fading away … cessation … giving away … letting go of greed, two things should be developed.”
